description: 한국남동발전(주)_발전소 주변농도 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국남동발전㈜. 삼천포 발전본부 변전소, 용산초등학교 인근 지역의 미세먼지(PM10), 아황산가스(SO₂), 이산화질소(NO₂)와 같이 국가에서 관리하는 주요 대기오염물질의 월평균 농도를 포함하고. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
